weekday_gap.question: Turn each tip into a fraction of the bill. Subtract Saturday's mean tip fraction from Friday's mean tip fraction. Return that Friday-minus-Saturday gap.
weekday_gap.reference:
tips["tip_pct"] = tips["tip"] / tips["total_bill"]
by_day = tips.groupby("day")["tip_pct"].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)

bd = tips.groupby("day")["tip_pct"].mean().round(4)
gap = round(bd["Fri"] - bd["Sat"], 4)

cases.input: Friday mean tip 18 and Saturday mean tip 15.
cases.expect: The gap is Friday minus Saturday, not the reverse.
